result.reason: The operative language gives Company a 30-day written-notice convenience right covering the Agreement and any in-flight Statement of Work, prohibits early-termination charges, and requires refund of prepaid fees attributable to the post-termination period. Contractor retains only the existing right to terminate when no Statement of Work is outstanding, so it has no convenience right during a committed engagement. The added payment and work-in-progress provisions are appropriately limited to termination consequences, though “without ... forfeiture of any amounts” is slightly imprecise and unnecessary.
